name: Front plank
why: A strong, stiff middle lets you dive and land without the body folding.

setup.space: A strip of floor about 2 m long.

steps: Lie face down with your forearms under your shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift so you rest on forearms and toes.
Make a straight line from head to heels by squeezing your bottom and tummy.
Breathe steadily, hold for the time, then lower your knees to the floor.

mistakes.fix: Squeeze the bottom and tuck the hips a little.
Lower the hips until the body is straight.

parent_check: Straight line from shoulder to ankle
Hips do not sag or pike
stop_if: Pain in the lower back or shoulders, or pain that changes how you move
Chest pain, dizziness, feeling faint, a racing heartbeat or unusual shortness of breath
Hips sag and cannot be lifted again (end the set)

easier.use_when: The hips sag before the time is up.

harder.variant: Lift one foot a little for two seconds, then the other.
harder.move_on_when: Every rep clean in two sessions in a row, and the owner approves the change.
